title: Pyramid of Pain
description: Interactive p5.js infographic of David Bianco's Pyramid of Pain. Hover each of the six indicator levels for an explanation, click for a sample SIEM detection rule, and toggle between Defender and Attacker views to see why detecting attackers higher up costs them more.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: David Bianco's Pyramid of Pain and indicator-based detection
learningObjectives: Explain why detecting attackers at higher pyramid levels imposes more cost on the adversary.
Identify what kind of indicator lives at each of the six levels.
Match a sample SIEM detection rule to the pyramid level it targets.
educational.prerequisites: Basic idea of indicators of compromise and a SIEM.

controls: Hover a pyramid level for what the indicator is and what detecting it forces the adversary to do
Click a level to reveal a sample SIEM detection rule
Select: Defender view (detection ideas) vs Attacker view (evasion cost)
pedagogical.assessment: Students place a given indicator (a file hash, a C2 domain, a PowerShell-encode behavior) at the correct pyramid level and explain the cost of detecting it.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating all indicators of compromise as equally valuable.
Believing blocking file hashes meaningfully slows a capable adversary.
